newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Idex FY98 estimate lifted.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Idex FY98 estimate lifted.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it raised its estimate for fiscal 1998 earnings for IDEX Corp to $3.45 a share from $3.43, although its fiscal 1997 estimate remained unchanged at $2.95.
-- EVEREN said operating margins at the company's Fluid Handling segment remained stable, while operating margins in the industrial products segment increased "meaningfully."
-- The company reported fourth-quarter earnings of $0.68 a share in fiscal 1996, compared with $0.58 a year ago, putting its 1996 earnings at $2.53 a share versus $2.30 in 1995.
-- IDEX makes fluid handling and other industrial products. Its shares were unchanged Wednesday at 40.
